Initialize the traversal stack with the root node.
**Mark Visited:** Add the current node to the visited set.
**Child Selection:** Determine which children of the current node are intersected by the ray.
**Push Children:** For each intersected child, push its pointer onto the stack.
**Termination:** If a leaf node is reached, record the intersection distance or hit point.
*   **Time Complexity:** Traversal time is proportional to the number of nodes visited.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Significantly lower than SVO due to node sharing.
